dogecoin.text:
Maybe incorporating Dogecoin into Twitter would be where the REAL money is. The value of Dogecoin, or any cryptocurrency Elon Musk may anoint would skyrocket. @elonmusk 

#NewYorkCoin hint hint

Twitter would be a better place if:

- Nobody was anonymous. I used to go by my real name here, and I'd do so again.
- People had to pay something, if only a penny per tweet.

Maybe @elonmusk will require a micropayment of #dogecoin per tweet. How much would Doge appreciate?
